services.desc: Fishing from Westport to Neah bay and Washington State’s Beautiful Puget Sound since 1995. Jeff’s primary focus has been on Salmon Fishing for Chinook, Coho and Pink Salmon although he is well-versed in Ling Cod, Flounder and Cabezon fishing as well. His local knowledge of the waters, along with his understanding of tide conditions, migration patterns, and patience with guest help set him apart. Jeff enjoys sharing his exuberant passion for fishing with clients who wish to experience the beauty and serene fishing opportunities Washington’s Puget Sound has to offer.
